title: Template:ProfIcon
wikitext:
Small Icon only template; links to the selected profession/skill:
* {{ProfIcon|Alchemy}} Alchemy
* {{ProfIcon|Blacksmithing}} Blacksmithing
* {{ProfIcon|Cooking}} Cooking
* {{ProfIcon|Enchanting}} Enchanting
* {{ProfIcon|Engineering}} Engineering
* {{ProfIcon|First Aid}} First Aid
* {{ProfIcon|Fishing}} Fishing
* {{ProfIcon|Herbalism}} Herbalism
* {{ProfIcon|Jewelcrafting}} Jewelcrafting
* {{ProfIcon|Leatherworking}} Leatherworking
* {{ProfIcon|Mining}} Mining
* {{ProfIcon|Riding}} Riding
* {{ProfIcon|Skinning}} Skinning
* {{ProfIcon|Survival}} Survival
* {{ProfIcon|Tailoring}} Tailoring
* {{ProfIcon|Lockpicking}} Lockpicking
* {{ProfIcon|Poisons}} Poisons

* {{t|ProfIcon|Profession}}
